text:
sara: Quick sync - Northgate wants to increase to 50 seats. Procurement insists on a 6mo pilot (discounted) that auto-converts to a 12mo term. They want SE onboarding next week; procurement needs acceptance path by EOD to hold the slot.
ethan: What discount band are they asking for?
sara: They asked for 15-20% on the pilot. buyer said conversion is automatic at list.
raphael: Finance note - shorter pilot increases churn risk. prefer at least partial upfront to reduce fallthrough.
contracts-bot: Check: delegated signer acceptable if PO includes name or if a signed Delegation of Authority exists. Recommend one-page Delegation Addendum.
procurement-team: We can include delegated signer field in the PO. Drafting now, ETA 2h.
billing: If they want split billing, we need invoice terms in the amendment: we can do 50% upfront for pilot + balance on conversion, or full upfront. Card-on-file option possible.
ethan: SE availability: we can hold Apr 12-16 if decision by EOD. Miss that and it'll slip 2 weeks.
raphael: Proposed options to present to customer: A) 6mo @ -18% with 50% upfront, Delegation Addendum, SE week hold; B) Convert-now 12mo at list price with full upfront and guaranteed SE.
sara: I'll send both. Also confirm delegated signer process and ask for PO scan if CFO is out.
procurement-team: PO draft sent to sara@northgate.com, includes delegated-signer checkbox + vendor code.
raphael: If they push for 0% upfront we should require stronger conversion guarantee (card on file + affirmative opt-in).
onboard-lead: From an enablement POV 50% upfront is fine. We can compress sessions to 3 days if needed. Prep docs will need to be shared before SE week.
sara: Buyer replied: "Option A preferred, CFO out Tue-Wed but procurement can sign. Can you fast-track delegation doc?"
contracts-bot: Creating Delegation Addendum template. Snippet: ```text
Delegation of Signature Authority — Organization authorizes [Name] to execute Amendment. Effective dates and scope included.
```
procurement-team: Noted - will accept Delegation Addendum PDF or PO with delegated signer name.
billing: Will accept 50% upfront via invoice. Please include billing reference KMS-42 in PO.
sara: Action items: 1) send Option A with clear billing mechanics 2) attach Delegation Addendum and PO template 3) hold SE week Apr12-16 tentatively 4) confirm payment method once PO signed.
ethan: pinging @finance for sign-off on 50% concession.
sara: I'll update thread when signed. Thanks team :thumbsup:
